source.note: 1973 Topps Baseball. The 660-card flagship checklist was physically issued in five 132-card series. VCS combines all five series into one collector-facing Base ProductSet with equal base-card availability. The 24 unnumbered Team Checklists are retained as a separate insert checklist; their one-star/two-star copyright-line variations are not modeled separately.

decisions.canonicalPackFormat: VCS-normalized pack: 4 cards per pack, 24 packs per box. The physical wax product was documented as ten cards per pack; VCS uses the standing four-card pack rule while retaining the physical box pack count.
decisions.seriesHandling: Physical Series 1-5 are combined into one complete Base ProductSet #1-660. The lower real-world print quantity of high numbers #529-660 is historical scarcity only and does not reduce their VCS base pull probability.
decisions.collectorChecklistIntegrity: Completion and prestige track the unified 660-card flagship checklist rather than five physical series.
decisions.variationHandling: TCDB ERR/COR/UER/VAR records that share one printed base card number are collapsed to the numbered #1-660 checklist. No error/correction or print-variation commentary is stored in Player or Variant.
decisions.trueRookieNaming: RC status is verified from TCDB's rookie index and RC notes. The current source resolves to 57 unique rookie card numbers. On multi-player Rookie cards #601-616, RC is applied player-by-player; established players on the same card are not mislabeled.
decisions.teamChecklistHandling: The 24 Team Checklists are unnumbered and receive deterministic VCS IDs NNO-01 through NNO-24. One-star and two-star copyright-line backs are collapsed. Sources confirm pack distribution only in limited Series Five/test-market packs plus a mail-in sheet, but do not provide a trustworthy universal insertion ratio, so oddsPerPack is intentionally null rather than invented.
decisions.packArt: Use one canonical early-series/Series One wax-pack image for the VCS Product when pack imagery is harvested.
decisions.releaseSafety: Product remains unreleased until pricing, images, and a deliberate Team Checklist pack-treatment decision are reviewed.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Complete flagship checklist #1-660. Five physical series are unified and equally available in VCS. Source error/correction/variation rows collapse to one card per printed number.

productSets.name: Team Checklists
productSets.notes: 24 unnumbered Team Checklists. VCS assigns NNO-01 through NNO-24 solely for unique internal checklist identity. One-star/two-star back variations are collapsed. Pack issue is verified, but exact universal insertion odds are not documented.
